missing_requirements: Pinned AMP upstream evidence establishes the default integration template, not a Salesforce receiver contract.
Customized AMP requests and variable/transport overrides may legitimately differ. Every presence diagnostic is default-template advice only.
Account IDs, client IDs, timing values, service operation, delivery and server acceptance remain external. No collector shutdown is inferred.
No field type, timing bounds, identity format or forced pageview=false constraint is imposed.
The unchanged legacy field extractor omits bare query keys; default templates use explicit key=value pairs.
Other Krux beacon routes and non-AMP transports remain outside automatic selection.
